description: Look up a cadastral parcel in 29 European countries (including the Basque Country and Navarre foral cadastres) by its official cadastral reference or by WGS84 coordinates. Returns the reference, location, address, municipality, area, land use and the parcel outline when the official source provides them. The country is detected from the reference format or the point when omitted. United Kingdom: coordinates only. Codes: ES Spain, PV Basque Country, NA Navarre, PT Portugal, FR France, IT Italy, DE Germany, AT Austria, CH Switzerland, LI Liechtenstein, BE Belgium, NL Netherlands, LU Luxembourg, PL Poland, CZ Czechia, SK Slovakia, SI Slovenia, HR Croatia, BG Bulgaria, GR Greece, CY Cyprus, DK Denmark, SE Sweden, NO Norway, FI Finland, IS Iceland, EE Estonia, LV Latvia, LT Lithuania, IE Ireland, UK United Kingdom.

country.description: Optional country code. Omit to auto-detect. PV and NA are the Spanish foral cadastres.

latitude.description: Latitude in WGS84 (use with longitude instead of reference)

longitude.description: Longitude in WGS84 (use with latitude instead of reference)

reference.description: Official cadastral reference as written in the country (e.g. 9872023VH5797S0001WX, 750560000AB0001)

name: get_parcel
title: Get Parcel
